purpose: Teach: 宅地/本数/常々/急行/チャージ/有給/待ち時間/少額

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新規宅地開発、住宅事業部、慎重に、進めろ、当社の評判、大事だ。
lines.en: New residential development project—housing division. Proceed carefully. Our reputation is on the line.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each phrase lands with weight. No rushing. Measured pauses between thoughts. The voice of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。生産ライン、本数、見直してまいります、効率化、必要ですね、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We'll review production line numbers. Efficiency improvements are really necessary.
lines.style: Steady, confirmatory. Slight nodding quality to the cadence. Thoughtful—he's already thinking through the logistics. Respectful but not submissive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 常々、社員に、お礼、伝えるよう、心がけている、感謝の気持ち、絶対、忘れるな。
lines.en: I make it a point to thank the staff. Gratitude—never let that slip away.
lines.style: Shift to something quieter, more personal. Less directive, more reflective. Lean in slightly. The weight of principle behind the words. A man checking that someone has understood what truly matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。打ち合わせ、急行で、来週、向かいます、お得意様の地方、ですね。
lines.en: Yes. We'll head out next week for the meeting with the key client in the region.
lines.style: Businesslike, affirming. Forward momentum in the tone. Quick, efficient. Not uncertain—he's already mapping the trip in his head.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 交通系ICカード、チャージ、社用、必ず、別会計に、しろ。
lines.en: Transportation card charges for company use—always separate accounts. No exceptions.
lines.style: Back to directive mode. Crisp, final. Each phrase a small rule. Not harsh, but unyielding. The tone of someone who has seen shortcuts cause problems.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の有給休暇、取得、促進中です、健康、第一に。
lines.en: Yes. We're actively promoting paid leave for staff. Health comes first.
lines.style: Responsive, acknowledging. Slight warmth here—a point of pride. Not defensive, but clear. The confirmation of someone who already knew this mattered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様の待ち時間、最小限に、抑えろ、現場、徹底させろ。
lines.en: Minimize customer wait times. Make sure that standard is enforced on the ground.
lines.style: Sharp, purposeful. The words have edges. Not angry—exacting. The tone shifts back to command. Expects this will be done without excuse.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。少額の経費、自動化、進めてまいります、本当に、急務ですね。
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with automating small expense processing. It's genuinely urgent.
lines.style: Closing confirmation. Picks up slightly in tempo—the conversation's winding down. Commitment in the voice. A trace of relief that alignment exists on priorities.
